title: The Last Chai at Hill View Hostel
setting: A college hostel in Pune during a monsoon power cut, 2026

victim.name: Professor Arvind Kale
victim.description: The strict hostel warden, found collapsed in his office at 11 pm after drinking his evening chai, poisoned.

intro:
The monsoon knocked out the power at Hill View Hostel at 9 pm. When the lights flickered back at 11, Professor Kale was found slumped over his desk, a half-empty cup of chai beside him.

The main gate was locked all evening, so the culprit is still inside. Four people had reason to visit the warden's office tonight. You have until morning to find out who.

suspects.name: Riya Desai
suspects.personality: Sarcastic, quick-witted, hides nerves with jokes
suspects.alibi: Studying in the library by candlelight all evening
suspects.motive: Kale was about to expel her for a hostel prank
suspects.secret: She sneaked out to a friend's party and climbed back over the wall

suspects.name: Mohan Pillai
suspects.personality: Gentle, formal, talks about his recipes
suspects.motive: Kale had accused him of stealing groceries
suspects.secret: He has been taking leftover food home to his family

suspects.name: Dr. Neha Joshi
suspects.role: Chemistry lecturer and Kale's rival for HOD
suspects.alibi: Grading papers in the staff room, never went near his office
suspects.motive: Kale planned to expose that she faked lab results
suspects.secret: She mixed the poison from lab supplies and slipped it into his chai during the blackout

suspects.name: Kabir Shah
suspects.alibi: Running the generator in the basement
suspects.secret: He owes money to a classmate and asked his uncle for a loan that night

locations.name: Warden's Office
locations.description: Kale's cramped office, papers everywhere, the chai cup still on the desk.

locations.name: Chemistry Lab
locations.description: The ground-floor lab, supposedly locked after 6 pm.

locations.name: Staff Room
locations.description: Where teachers grade papers; a single candle burned down to a stub.

locations.name: Hostel Kitchen
locations.description: Where the evening chai was brewed in one big pot.

clues.text: A faint smell of bitter almonds rises from the chai cup, and a lab-style glass dropper lies under the desk.
A draft letter on the desk reads: 'To the Principal: I have proof that Dr. Joshi's published results were fabricated.'
The lab door was unlocked with a key, not forced. The sign-out sheet shows 'N. Joshi, 9:20 pm' in a hurried hand.
The pile of papers Dr. Joshi claims she graded is untouched; the top answer sheet has no marks at all.
The chai pot is still half full and Mohan drank from it himself, so the poison was added to Kale's cup, not the pot.
Muddy footprints by the back window belong to someone wearing party sandals, not a teacher's shoes.

solution: Dr. Neha Joshi poisoned Professor Kale to stop him exposing her fabricated research. During the blackout she took a dropper of poison from the chemistry lab (her 9:20 pm sign-out), slipped it into his cup, and returned to the staff room. Her untouched papers prove she was not grading as she claimed, and the dropper and draft letter tie her to the crime. The muddy footprints were Riya sneaking back from a party.

title: The Vanishing Ravi Varma
setting: The Heritage Art Museum, Kolkata, on the night of its 100th anniversary gala

victim.name: Mrs. Indira Sen
victim.description: The museum's founder, whose prized Raja Ravi Varma painting was found missing from its frame at 10:15 pm, replaced by a printed copy.

intro:
Two hundred guests in silk and sherwanis were sipping mishti doi on the terrace when the curator noticed the brushstrokes on the gala's star painting looked flat. Up close, it was a high-quality print.

The real painting was on the wall at 8 pm, when the press took photos. The doors have been sealed since. Four people had keys to the gallery wing tonight.

suspects.name: Arnab Ghosh
suspects.personality: Fussy, proud, quotes art history constantly
suspects.alibi: Giving a speech on the terrace from 9 to 9:30, then mingling with guests
suspects.motive: Mrs. Sen announced she would replace him next month
suspects.secret: He has been quietly selling minor museum sketches to a private dealer

suspects.name: Tanya Mehra
suspects.role: Restoration expert hired for the gala
suspects.personality: Calm, friendly, speaks softly and chooses words carefully
suspects.alibi: Packing her tools in the basement workshop all evening
suspects.motive: Deep in debt after her studio failed
suspects.secret: She printed the replica weeks ago, swapped it in during the 9 pm speech, and hid the canvas rolled inside a tube of restoration paper

suspects.name: Rahul Sen
suspects.personality: Charming, bored, makes jokes about everything
suspects.alibi: At the bar on the terrace all night
suspects.motive: He wants the painting sold so the family can cash in
suspects.secret: He slipped out to smoke in the loading bay, which his grandmother forbade

suspects.name: Kiran Das
suspects.alibi: Watching the CCTV monitors in the guard room
suspects.motive: Underpaid and recently refused a raise
suspects.secret: He dozed off at the monitors for twenty minutes around 9 pm

locations.name: Main Gallery
locations.description: The high-ceilinged hall where the painting hung.

locations.name: Basement Workshop
locations.description: The restoration room full of solvents, canvases and paper rolls.

locations.name: Guard Room
locations.description: A small room with a wall of CCTV screens.

locations.name: Loading Bay
locations.description: The back exit where art crates are delivered.

clues.text: Fresh flecks of conservator's wax on the frame's back edge, the kind used to re-seat canvases.
An extra-wide tube of restoration paper is stamped 'T. Mehra - outgoing shipment', far heavier than paper alone should be.
Tanya's tool bag is still unpacked, and the workshop light timer shows it was switched off from 8:50 to 9:40 pm.
The CCTV log has a 20-minute gap at 9:05 pm; the recording was paused manually, not by a power cut.
Cigarette ends and Rahul's lighter lie by the door, but the outgoing crate seal is unbroken.

solution: Tanya Mehra stole the painting. While everyone listened to the 9 pm speech, she paused the CCTV while the guard dozed, used conservator's wax to re-seat the printed replica in the frame, and rolled the real canvas into a tube of restoration paper labelled for shipment. Her workshop light was off during the theft and her bag was never packed, breaking her alibi. Rahul's cigarettes are only a red herring.

title: Ctrl + Alt + Defeat
setting: The engineering block of a Bengaluru college, the night before the national hackathon finals

victim.name: Team Nova
victim.description: The favourite team, whose demo laptop was found wiped and its backup drive snapped in half at 6 am, three hours before judging.

intro:
Team Nova had built a drone that maps flooded streets, and everyone expected them to win. At 6 am their captain opened the lab to find their laptop showing a factory reset screen and their backup drive broken on the floor.

The lab was locked from midnight, and the access card log shows four people entered overnight. Judging starts at 9.

suspects.name: Aditya Kulkarni
suspects.personality: Competitive, loud, brags about his GitHub streak
suspects.alibi: Coding in the library until 4 am, then asleep in the hostel
suspects.motive: ByteForce came second to Nova at the last two events
suspects.secret: His team quietly reused code from an old open-source project without credit

suspects.name: Meera Iyer
suspects.personality: Quiet, precise, answers questions with questions
suspects.alibi: Asleep in the girls' hostel from midnight
suspects.motive: The captain left her name off the project poster and the startup pitch
suspects.secret: She entered the lab at 2 am with her own card, ran the factory reset and snapped the drive, planning to rebuild the demo alone and claim the credit

suspects.name: Prof. Suresh Rao
suspects.personality: Tired, strict, constantly checking his watch
suspects.alibi: Checked the lab once at 11 pm, then went home
suspects.motive: Nova ignored his advice and he was embarrassed in front of the dean
suspects.secret: He came back at 1 am to borrow a 3D printer for his son's school project

suspects.name: Faizal Khan
suspects.alibi: Doing a night shift checking the servers
suspects.motive: Nova's captain complained about him to the HOD
suspects.secret: He was streaming a cricket match on the lab projector instead of working

locations.name: Robotics Lab
locations.description: Where the wiped laptop and the broken drive were found.

locations.name: Access Control Room
locations.description: The office that keeps the card swipe records.

locations.name: Girls' Hostel Gate
locations.description: The gate with a sign-in book for late returns.

clues.text: The reset was started from the laptop's admin account, whose password only Team Nova members know.
A 3D printer still holds a half-finished toy dinosaur, started at 1:05 am.
Card log: Rao 1:00 am, I. Meera 2:12 am, Khan in and out all night. Aditya's card never entered the block.
The projector history shows a cricket stream running from midnight to 3 am.
The late-entry book shows Meera Iyer signing back in at 2:47 am, though she says she was asleep from midnight.

solution: Meera Iyer sabotaged her own team. Angry at being left out of the credit, she used her card to enter the lab at 2:12 am, reset the laptop with the team's admin password and snapped the backup drive, then signed back into the hostel at 2:47 am. The card log and the hostel book break her alibi. The professor's 3D print and Faizal's cricket stream are red herrings.
